'''Samus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Sith Inquisitor]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He resided in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where he provided martial training for [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]]. Samus had pale skin, [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and whilst in the academy had a bald head and wore red and black [[Sith apparel|robes]].<ref name="SWTOR:AFC" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
One acolyte he trained, who was directed to him by Assistant [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Markan]], went on to become the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Darth Zash]], and eventually became [[Darth Nox]].<ref name="SWTOR:AFC" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Samus first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which he played a part in the quest "A Fighting Chance". The quest was for the Sith Inquisitor class only and directed them to a class trainer, a role which Samus provided in the game.
